Other candidates like 'Renaissance man', 'artist', 'musician', 'official', and 'commander' are either descriptive titles, generic terms, or refer to others (e.g., 'commander' refers to Colonel Peter van der Meer in D2S5). Specific roles like 'director of the Art for All initiative' or 'board member' are not explicitly stated as his title (he is the 'top official' and the initiative is his 'first initiative', not necessarily a directorship title).
